history.summary: Brand-new 2024 463 sqft 1BR freehold at Verticus in Balestier (D12), $2,117 psf vs $2,315 median. Freehold tenure and sub-median PSF are positives, but appreciation is weak (2.1%/yr resale-only after bias adjustment), the MRT is a poor 1.35km/16-min walk, and Balestier has heavy 1BR supply.
history.rating_rationale: Freehold and a sub-median entry ($2,117 vs $2,315) give some support, but the negatives stack up: honest resale-only appreciation only 2.1%/yr (new-launch bias flagged), a poor 1.35km walk to Toa Payoh MRT, and Balestier's well-known glut of shoebox/1BR units competing for the same tenants. Score_1000 of 504 (market-typical) and weak elo (1006). Freehold cushions downside but the location and supply dynamics cap upside.
red_flags: Weak 2.1%/yr resale-only appreciation; new-launch bias flagged
catalysts: Freehold tenure — no lease decay, downside protection
Central Balestier location near Novena medical hub and CBD fringe
